label: Copy step 1 when the first original token was digit 0 (fed-back input 0 right after <DEL>), L 4-8
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, at exactly the second copy step (recall_idx 1, prev input <DEL>), when the fed-back input is digit 0, meaning the first original token was 0. All 26840 activations are one per sequence at this position. It never fires during the original or delimiter phase, never on other input tokens, and not when 0 shows up later in the sequence. It is silent for L=3 and almost silent for L=9 (257 weak activations out of about 17k candidates). Magnitude falls as L grows: L=4-7 carry most of the mass, L=8 activations are weak (about 0.3 of mean), and L=9 is near zero. The token being output (orig(1)) and the other tokens do not change it. Dev F1 0.976 with the L 4-8 restriction, 0.89 without it.

issues: Minor point: all 417 test false positives are at L=8 (step 9). At L=8 the predicate's precision is 0.855 (2881 predicted). For L 4-7 it is 1.000. I split the L=8 cases by in_count, n_digits, out_tok type (digit or vowel), orig(1)=='0' and correct. Precision stayed between 0.83 and 0.87 every time, so these look like activations falling under threshold as magnitude drops, not a missing condition. The explanation already says L=8 activations are weak (4.9% of mass at L=8 on test).

Minor point: 267 test activations fall outside the predicate. They are all at L=9 recall_idx 1 with input 0, with activations of 0.00-0.07 relative to the max, and together hold 0.2% of the mass. Adding L=9 to the predicate gives precision 0.086 there. Excluding L=9 is correct, and the explanation discloses these activations.
Negligible: 17 dev activations are at recall_idx 2, which slightly contradicts 'exactly the second copy step'. (recall_idx==2)&(in_tok==0) scores F1 0.001.

The other claims hold. Phase: original 0, delimiter 0, copy 1.000. in_tok: 0 carries 100% of activation mass. L=3: 0 activations out of 438 predicted. Steps active equal sequences active (13424/13424 on dev), so it fires once per sequence. On test, in_tok==0 and orig(0)==0 give identical scores at recall_idx 1, and there are no cases with correct==0. Test results: F1 0.975 with the L 4-8 restriction and 0.885 without it, matching the report.
